svg_description: Flexible engineering judgment selects intended calls. A typed call contract is checked by parity against the current authoritative dependency map. That map and environment-specific deployment identities feed deterministic grant derivation, a concrete grant plan, application, and per-grant results. Installed IAM bindings govern invocation at a separate runtime boundary. Service-name correspondence is not an IAM check. Moving model authority requires a separate consumer migration.
